full_name: Romuald Karmakar | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Arts David and Roberta Logie Fellow and Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow Independent Filmmaker (Germany)
bio: Romuald Karmakar is an independent filmmaker based in Berlin. His first fiction film, Der Totmacher (The Deathmaker; 1995), an intimate portrait of lower-middle-class life based on the psychiatric examination records of a mass murderer in Germany in the 1920s, was awarded a Coppa Volpi for best actor at the Venice Film Festival and three German Film Awards.
